cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet rooftop citrus garden at a small modern cafe — she savours a freshly peeled orange wedge while proudly displaying the long unbroken spiral peel as a tiny trophy; the central atrium of a space station — carries her keepsake low at her side; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — holds a cup in both hands; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a bus shelter on a quiet street — holds a smartphone at chest height; the grand staircase of an old castle — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet lakeside paddleboat dock with a pink pedal boat tied beside the timber platform — she triumphantly lifts a tiny paper victory flag after winning a leisurely solo paddleboat time trial; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — lying on her front; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — looks into a small brass telescope; her bedroom — holds a book closed against her chest; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — standing; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — stitches into a small embroidery hoop with fabric in it
